'''''Twilight's Kiss''''' was a space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] that was owned by [[Cularin Star Tours]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was hired by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sargo VenHalgon]] and he along with [[VenHalgon|Lady VenHalgon]], his minister [[Cannison (Minister)|Cannison]], [[Mrs. Cannison]], [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Worrita (Professor)|Worrita]], [[Worrita (Mrs)|Mrs. Worrita]] and the [[valet droid]] [[LF-R3D]] toured the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in it. They landed it in the jungle on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and the men left to go hunting. After they didn't return, the women left to find them. When they didn't come back, LF-R3D contacted the crew of the CST safety ship ''[[Starchaser IV]]'', which flew over to investigate and landed next to the ''Kiss''.
